# API Reference Autogen — Sub-spec 4b Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Generate the auto-generated API reference for the Nexus monorepo, hosted at `api.nexusactors.com`. Loads the sub-spec 4a phpdoc-templates-plugin so generic types render correctly. Tags ~25–30 engine internals `@internal` so they don't pollute the public surface. Backfills PHPDoc summaries on the top-25 front-door classes. Hand-writes the top-25 narrative pages in the Docusaurus `Reference/` section. Wires CI to rebuild + deploy on every `main` push.

**Architecture:** phpDocumentor v3 + Nexus plugin runs in Docker against the full Nexus monorepo (`packages/*/src`). Output is static HTML deployed to a Cloudflare Pages project (`nexus-actors-api`) on subdomain `api.nexusactors.com`. CI workflow rebuilds on changes to `packages/**/src/**` or `phpdoc.dist.xml`. The plugin is consumed via a composer **path repository** (V1 — published to Packagist post-V1) so the api-deploy workflow includes the plugin source in the same git context.

**Tech Stack:** phpDocumentor v3.10 + nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin (PHP 8.4 build container), Docker, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Pages, Docusaurus (for the narrative `Reference/` pages — same site as sub-spec 2).

## Global Constraints

Every task in this plan must honor these (from spec §2, §8.3, §8.4 + CLAUDE.md):

- **Docker for everything.** phpDocumentor runs only inside its own container (the plugin's `phpdoc-templates-plugin:dev` image, or a sibling image). Never invoke phpdoc on the host.
- **Plugin is local (path repo) for V1.** Sub-spec 4a's plugin lives at `.claude/worktrees/phpdoc-templates-plugin/` (or wherever it ends up checked out). The `phpdoc.dist.xml` at the Nexus repo root references it via composer path repo. Publishing to GitHub + Packagist is post-V1.
- **No `Co-Authored-By: Claude` trailer on commits.** Project rule.
- **New commits only, no `--amend`.** If a check fails, fix forward.
- **Pre-approved hook+GPG bypass** for the docs/v1-launch branch (same environmental constraints — worktree+Docker grumphp + no pinentry): `--no-verify --no-gpg-sign` on every commit, documented in body.
- **Conventional commit prefixes:** `chore(api):` for config + CI; `feat(api):` for new content (Reference pages); `chore(docs):` for `@internal` tags and docblock backfill in `packages/*/src`; `fix(api):` for fixes.
- **`@internal`-tagged classes are EXCLUDED from public API surface but remain crawlable for deep-links** (per spec §8.3, closing second-pass finding 9). Their phpDocumentor-generated pages still exist; they're just hidden from sidebar/index.
- **Backfill scope is the top-25 front-door classes only** for V1. Other packages' classes get autogenerated pages with whatever docblocks exist; they're not hidden, but they don't have hand-written prose introducing them.
- **All work lands on `docs/v1-launch`** branch (the long-lived integration branch per spec §9.9), NOT directly to `main`. Sub-spec 0 already merged to main; the api-deploy.yml workflow will only deploy when `docs/v1-launch` merges to main at the promotion moment.

## Task 2: Tag engine internals `@internal`

**Files:**
- Modify: each engine-internal class file from Task 1 — add `/** @internal */` PHPDoc tag on the class.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the internals list from Task 1.
- Produces: source files with `@internal` PHPDoc tags. phpDocumentor v3 default `phpdoc.xml` config excludes `@internal`-tagged classes from rendered output IFF the visibility config includes `public` (default). With `<setting name="graphs.enabled" value="false" />` + the default visibility settings, internals are excluded.

The Psalm plugin already understands `@internal` (it's a standard tag). No Psalm config changes needed.

- [ ] **Step 1: Inspect one candidate to see existing docblock shape**

```bash
cat packages/nexus-core/src/Actor/Behavior/EmptyBehavior.php | head -20
```

Most likely there's already a `final readonly class` with no class-level docblock, OR a one-line docblock. We add `@internal` either alongside the existing summary or as a new docblock if absent.

- [ ] **Step 2: Edit each file in the list**

For each path from Task 1's internals list, add `@internal` to the class's PHPDoc. Two cases:

**Case A: file has no class-level docblock yet.** Add one:
```php
/**
 * @internal Implementation detail of {@see Behavior}. Not for direct use.
 */
final class EmptyBehavior implements ...
```

**Case B: file has an existing class-level docblock.** Add `@internal` as a tag line:
```php
/**
 * Empty behavior used when an actor has no message handler yet.
 *
 * @internal Implementation detail of {@see Behavior}. Not for direct use.
 */
final class EmptyBehavior implements ...
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Run Nexus's static analysis to confirm no regressions**

```bash
cd /Users/tomas/Work/Monadial/CodeOSS/nexus
make psalm
make phpcs
make cs
```

Expected: all clean. The `@internal` tag is informational; Psalm-level-1 doesn't enforce it.

- [ ] **Step 4: Run Nexus's full test suite to confirm nothing breaks**

```bash
make test
```

Expected: 1109 tests pass (same as plan 0's bumped baseline).

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add packages/nexus-core/src
git commit --no-verify --no-gpg-sign -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(docs): tag ~28 engine internals @internal for API ref exclusion

Sub-spec 4b deliverable §8.3 item 1. Tags engine-internal classes with
@internal so phpDocumentor excludes them from the rendered sidebar/index
of api.nexusactors.com while leaving their HTML pages crawlable for
deep-links. List enumerated in
docs/superpowers/notes/2026-06-19-subspec-4b-class-lists.md.

These are implementation details of Behavior / ActorCell / Stash and
should never be referenced directly by user code:
- ActorCell, DefaultStashBuffer, …Behavior wrapper classes (11 total)

Verification: make test (1109 pass), make psalm + phpcs + cs all clean.

Hook + GPG signing bypassed (pre-approved).
EOF
)"

## Task 3: Add `phpdoc-templates-plugin` as composer path repository

**Files:**
- Modify: `composer.json` (root) — add a `repositories` entry for the plugin path.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing.
- Produces: the plugin available via `composer require --dev nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin:*@dev` at the Nexus repo root.

- [ ] **Step 1: Inspect current `composer.json` repositories section**

```bash
cat composer.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d.get('repositories',[]), indent=2))"
```

Note any existing path repos. Plan to add ours alongside.

- [ ] **Step 2: Edit `composer.json`**

Add to the `repositories` array:

```json
{
    "type": "path",
    "url": ".claude/worktrees/phpdoc-templates-plugin",
    "options": {
        "symlink": false
    }
}
```

Why `symlink: false`: the plugin lives in a git-worktree under `.claude/` which is git-ignored. A symlink would break inside Docker because the bind-mount only exposes `/app` (the Nexus root), not parent dirs. Setting `symlink: false` copies the plugin into `vendor/`, which works inside Docker.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the plugin as a dev dependency**

```bash
cd /Users/tomas/Work/Monadial/CodeOSS/nexus
docker compose exec -T php composer require --dev nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin:dev-main 2>&1 | tail -10
```

Expected: composer resolves the local path repo and installs the plugin into `vendor/`. The plugin has its own composer.json requiring `php: >=8.4`. Nexus is on PHP 8.5.7 — both satisfy `>=8.4`.

If composer complains about the plugin's PHP constraint (8.4 vs Nexus's 8.5.7), use `--ignore-platform-req=php` for now since the plugin only runs in its own Docker container, not in the Nexus PHP context. (The actual phpdoc run happens in the plugin's own image — see Task 4.)

- [ ] **Step 4: Verify install**

```bash
ls vendor/nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin/composer.json
```

Expected: file exists.

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add composer.json composer.lock
git commit --no-verify --no-gpg-sign -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(api): add phpdoc-templates-plugin as composer path repository (dev)

Sub-spec 4b deliverable. Wires the local sub-spec 4a plugin into Nexus's
composer dev dependencies so phpDocumentor (run in Docker per Task 4)
can load the @template/@psalm-template/@phpstan-template renderer.

V1: path repo pointing at .claude/worktrees/phpdoc-templates-plugin/.
Post-V1: publish plugin to Packagist + switch this to a regular require-dev.

symlink: false so composer copies the plugin into vendor/ — required
because the worktree path isn't visible inside the Docker bind-mount.

Hook + GPG signing bypassed (pre-approved).
EOF
)"
```

## Task 5: PHPDoc backfill on the top-25 front-door classes

**Files:**
- Modify: each top-25 class file from Task 1's enumerated list.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: top-25 list from Task 1.
- Produces: each top-25 class has a substantive class-level docblock summary (≥ 2 non-tag lines) and class-level + method-level descriptions on public constructors + public factory methods + public command methods.

**Scope discipline:** ~50 hours per spec §8.3 — that's a real cost. Each class:
- 1 class-level docblock with: one-line summary, one paragraph elaborating, 1–3 example usages where relevant, `@see` to related classes.
- For each public method (excluding getters auto-promoted from readonly props): 1 short summary + `@param` lines if they aren't already documented + `@return` if non-obvious.

DO NOT touch:
- Private/protected methods (out of scope — phpDocumentor `visibility>public` excludes them anyway, but `protected` is also rendered per Task 4 config — judgment call: tag with summaries if they're commonly subclassed, skip otherwise).
- Methods that are already documented satisfactorily.
- Anything outside the top-25 list.

This task is best split across multiple commits (~5 classes per commit, ~5 commits total) to keep diff sizes reviewable.

- [ ] **Step 1: Identify which top-25 classes already have substantive docblocks**

```bash
for cls_path in $(cat docs/superpowers/notes/2026-06-19-subspec-4b-class-lists.md | grep '^- packages/' | awk '{print $2}'); do
  doc_lines=$(awk '/^\/\*\*/,/^\s*\*\//' "$cls_path" | grep -c '^\s*\*' || echo 0)
  echo "$cls_path → docblock lines: $doc_lines"
done
```

Classes with `< 2` docblock lines need backfill. Classes with `> 5` lines are already well-documented; just spot-check + skip if good.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write backfill for the first ~5 classes** (Duration, ActorSystem, Behavior, Props, ActorRef)

For each, draft a class-level summary + paragraph + public-method summaries. Re-run `make psalm + phpcs + cs` after each file to catch any issues.

Example pattern (`ActorSystem.php`):

```php
/**
 * The entry point for spawning actors and running an actor system.
 *
 * An ActorSystem is the top-level container for actors in your application.
 * You typically create one per process, configure it with a Runtime (Fiber,
 * Swoole, or Step), and use it to spawn the root actors of your supervision
 * tree.
 *
 * Example:
 * ```php
 * $system = ActorSystem::create('my-app', new FiberRuntime());
 * $ref = $system->spawn(Props::fromBehavior($greeter), 'greeter');
 * $ref->tell(new Greet('world'));
 * $system->run();

# Internal classes

These classes are part of Nexus's runtime implementation but are
**not part of the public API surface**. They are tagged `@internal`
in source so they do not appear in the public sidebar of
[api.nexusactors.com](https://api.nexusactors.com).

Their HTML pages still exist for deep-links; this page lists them

| … (rest of internals list) |

discuss promoting the relevant API to public.

## Task 7: GitHub Actions workflow for api.nexusactors.com deploy

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/api-deploy.yml`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 2–5 (phpdoc.dist.xml + tagged sources + the plugin via composer path).
- Produces: a CI workflow that on push to `main` affecting `packages/**/src/**` or `phpdoc.dist.xml` rebuilds the API site and pushes it to the `nexus-actors-api` Cloudflare Pages project.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the workflow**

```yaml
name: api.nexusactors.com — phpDocumentor deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'packages/**/src/**'
      - 'phpdoc.dist.xml'
      - '.github/workflows/api-deploy.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/**/src/**'
      - 'phpdoc.dist.xml'
      - '.github/workflows/api-deploy.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: api-deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Nexus
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout phpdoc-templates-plugin
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin
          path: .ci/phpdoc-templates-plugin
          ref: main
        # Note: when plugin is still local-only (V1), use a different strategy:
        # commit the plugin tarball or use git subtree. For V1, the simplest
        # workaround is to skip CI deploy until the plugin is published.
        # See "V1 deploy caveat" at end of plan.

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build phpdoc-templates-plugin image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .ci/phpdoc-templates-plugin
          tags: phpdoc-templates-plugin:ci
          load: true
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=phpdoc-plugin
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=phpdoc-plugin

      - name: Install plugin composer deps
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v ${{ github.workspace }}/.ci/phpdoc-templates-plugin:/app \
            phpdoc-templates-plugin:ci composer install --no-interaction

      - name: Run phpDocumentor against Nexus
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/nexus \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}/.ci/phpdoc-templates-plugin:/plugin \
            -w /nexus \
            phpdoc-templates-plugin:ci \
            /plugin/vendor/bin/phpdoc --config=phpdoc.dist.xml --force

      - name: Verify output
        run: |
          test -f build/api-nexus/index.html
          test -f build/api-nexus/api-classes.json
          test -f build/api-nexus/classes/Monadial-Nexus-Core-Actor-ActorRef.html

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: cloudflare/pages-action@v1
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          projectName: nexus-actors-api
          directory: build/api-nexus
          branch: main

      - name: Comment PR with preview URL
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: cloudflare/pages-action@v1
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          projectName: nexus-actors-api
          directory: build/api-nexus
          branch: pr-${{ github.event.number }}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Note the V1 deploy caveat**

The above workflow assumes the plugin lives at `github.com/nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin`. For V1, the plugin is local-only (per plan-4a Task 11 Option B). Options:

1. **Skip CI deploy in V1.** Comment out the deploy step. Local `make api-deploy` triggered manually by a maintainer with Cloudflare credentials. Document in commit body.
2. **Publish the plugin first.** Push plan-4a's plugin to `github.com/nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-plugin` BEFORE merging this task. The plan recommended deferring publish; reconsider for CI viability.
3. **Vendor the plugin into the Nexus repo.** Commit the plugin source under `.ci/phpdoc-templates-plugin/` as a git subtree. Couples plugin updates to Nexus releases.

**Recommendation:** Option 1 for V1. The CI workflow file lands with the deploy step commented out. Manual deploy works. Re-enable CI once the plugin is published to GitHub.

- [ ] **Step 3: Commit**

```bash
git add .github/workflows/api-deploy.yml
git commit --no-verify --no-gpg-sign -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(ci): add api-deploy.yml workflow for api.nexusactors.com

Sub-spec 4b deliverable. Workflow runs phpDocumentor against the Nexus
monorepo (all 22 packages with src/, nexus-psalm excluded) using the
sub-spec 4a phpdoc-templates-plugin loaded from a checkout. Output
deploys to Cloudflare Pages project nexus-actors-api on push to main.

PRs get a preview deployment URL comment.

V1 caveat: deploy step is COMMENTED OUT because the phpdoc-templates-
plugin hasn't been published to github.com/nexus-actors/phpdoc-templates-
plugin yet (per plan-4a Task 11 Option B — deferred to post-V1). Local
deploy works: `docker run ... phpdoc-templates-plugin:dev ...` then
push the output dir to Cloudflare Pages manually.

Re-enable the deploy step in a follow-up commit once the plugin is on
GitHub.

Required GitHub secrets (set in repo settings before re-enabling):
- CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
- CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID

Hook + GPG signing bypassed (pre-approved).
EOF
)"
```
